description:
[Original Webtoon](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%ED%86%B5-%EC%86%8D%EC%9D%98-%EB%B8%8C%EB%A0%88%EC%9D%B8/2775)  
The mad witch who lives in the mountains cut off people's heads and collects them.'

Lamark, a small town where all the citizens were annihilated by a witch.

The only rope the mayor could hold on to, who survived alone, was the necromancer Brain, whom he despised for committing taboos.

Brain, who received a large amount of money,

He goes on the road with his daughter, Zombie Eri.

The two of them track down the witch after all preparations. However, they ended up being decapitated by the witch's subordinate 'Guillotine'.

In the end, the heads of the father and daughter in the barrel like a stuffed specimen degenerate into a collectible on the shelf.

But it wasn't a defeat for Brain, a necromancer who handles corpses and death...

What if we were brains in a vat?

A fantasy reversal escape drama of a decapitated necromancer.
